title: Okapi BM25 Scoring
signature: def bm25_scores(docs: list, query: str, k1: float = 1.5, b: float = 0.75) -> np.ndarray
hints: Tokenize the documents and the query with s.lower().split(). Compute every document's length and the average length.
The Lucene idf is log(1 + (N - df + 0.5) / (df + 0.5)). It is always positive, unlike the classic Robertson form.
The tf part is tf * (k1 + 1) / (tf + k1 * (1 - b + b * len(d) / avgdl)). b controls how much long documents are penalized.
Loop over the query tokens including repeats; each one adds idf * tf-part to every document's score.
